Dream 2026-11-22 linked 7 vignettes from 5 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- 2026-10-22 · retells · "We need to establish a good practice guide and set of examples for how to form decsions." (A good practice guide for forming decisions (2026-10-22))
- 2026-10-22 · retells · "decisions need to be formed correctly in order to mean something" (Decisions formed correctly, a taxonomy through practice (2026-10-22))
- 2026-10-30 · retells · "Lets record a clear rationale. How would we tell whether we made the wrong decision or need to change?" (Vignette 2026-10-30: a decision records its rationale and how we would know it was wrong)
- 2026-10-30 · touches · "We should make a decision only when we know what the options really are and the pros and cons." (Vignette 2026-10-30: the first iteration of a registry, lock down only the smallest piece)
- 2026-11-03 · retells · "No decision should just be a branch without a rationale." (Setting up work takes longer than the work; decisions need a case, not a branch (2026-11-03))
- 2026-11-05 · touches · "work to improve the quality of decision records" (Owner: decisions are very hard to judge, so I tend to just click "recommended" (2026-11-05))
- 2026-11-07 · touches · "The axes may tend to work best on decisions. SRS and srs-rust should have a set of decision logs" (Map the muSrs sources; the Systemic Data Ethics 4x3 map classified standards and GDPR; axes may work best on decisions, and srs and srs-rust have decision logs (2026-11-07))
